All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for story 021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX are implemented and verified: - File-level @supports template with clear placeholders is automatically inserted when missing, controlled by `autoFixTestTemplate` and optionally customized via `testSupportsTemplate` (REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PLACEHOLDER). - Malformed `[REQ-XXX]` prefixes in test names are safely normalized for spaces, underscores, parentheses, and casing without inventing new requirement IDs, only when a recognizable REQ identifier is already present (REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT, REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE). - Auto-fixes operate only on comments and test name string literals, preserve quoting and surrounding code structure, and are guarded so no fix is applied when it would be ambiguous or unsafe (REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE). - Behavior is fully integrated into the ESLint rule (`meta.fixable: "code"`) and exercised via Jest RuleTester tests that assert before/after code for all key scenarios; the full test suite passes. - User documentation in `user-docs/api-reference.md` explicitly describes these auto-fix capabilities and the template format.
Based on this concrete code and test evidence, the story is fully implemented and passes.
